title: Cardinal Billing Account Due-Day Change and Midterm Plan Change Limits
content:
How far and how often the installment due day of a Cardinal Billing Account may move, and whether the account may leave its pay plan during the term, are set by the pay plan.

| Pay plan | Due-day changes allowed in one term | Largest move in one change (calendar days) | May leave the plan during the term |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Direct Bill Monthly Plan | 1 | 10 | Yes |
| Cardinal Card Autopay Monthly Plan | 1 | 10 | Yes |
| Cardinal EFT Autopay Monthly Plan | 2 | 15 | Yes |
| Cardinal Three-Pay Plan | 1 | 10 | Yes |
| Cardinal Two-Pay Plan | 1 | 10 | Yes |
| Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan | 0 | 0 | No |

## Points of judgement

- The Cardinal EFT Autopay Monthly Plan is the most flexible: 2 due-day changes in a term, each moving the due day by up to 15 calendar days.
- The Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan allows no due-day change and no midterm change of pay plan.
- Hypothetical: on the Cardinal Direct Bill Monthly Plan a move from the 5th to the 15th of the month is a move of 10 days and fits the limit; a move from the 5th to the 16th is 11 days and does not.
